exercises.name: Bench press
exercises.about: The classic chest builder. Lie with eyes under the bar, feet planted, shoulder blades pinched. Lower to mid-chest, press up and slightly back. Keep wrists stacked over elbows.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
exercises.about: Flat press with a dumbbell in each hand, so each side works on its own and you get a deeper stretch. Lower until elbows are just below the bench, then press up and slightly in.

exercises.name: Machine chest press
exercises.about: A guided press that lets you push hard without balancing a bar. Set the seat so handles line up with mid-chest, keep your back on the pad and press until arms are nearly straight.

exercises.name: Smith bench press
exercises.about: Bench press on a fixed track. Position the bench so the bar touches mid-chest. Good for pushing near failure without a spotter; use the safety hooks.

exercises.name: Push-up
exercises.about: Hands a bit wider than shoulders, body in a straight line from head to heels. Lower your chest to the floor and push back up. Make it harder by raising your feet or adding weight.

exercises.name: Dips
exercises.about: On parallel bars, lean forward a little and lower until shoulders are just below elbows, then press up. Leaning forward hits chest more; staying upright shifts it to triceps.

exercises.name: Decline bench press
exercises.about: Bench press with the head lower than the hips. Shorter range and easy on the shoulders; bring the bar to the lower chest.

exercises.name: Decline dumbbell press
exercises.about: Dumbbell press on a decline bench. Lower chest focus with a long, comfortable stretch.

exercises.name: Barbell floor press
exercises.about: Bench press lying on the floor. Elbows stop on the floor, which cuts the range and spares the shoulders while overloading the lockout.

exercises.name: Dumbbell floor press
exercises.about: Dumbbell press from the floor. Pause the elbows lightly on the ground each rep. A good shoulder-friendly option.

exercises.name: Kettlebell floor press
exercises.about: Press a kettlebell from the floor with the bell resting on the back of the forearm. Keep the wrist straight.

exercises.name: Cable chest press
exercises.about: Standing or seated press between two cable stacks. Constant tension all the way through; step forward to load the start.

exercises.name: Plate-loaded chest press
exercises.about: Plate-loaded press with independent arms. Load it heavy; press each side evenly and control the way back.

exercises.name: Weighted push-up
exercises.about: A push-up with a plate on your back or a weight vest. Log the added weight; keep the hips from sagging.

exercises.name: Deficit push-up
exercises.about: Push-up with hands on plates or handles so the chest can go below hand level. More stretch for the chest.

exercises.name: Band chest press
exercises.about: Anchor a band behind you at chest height and press forward. Handy at home or as a finisher. Log reps; use a stronger band to progress.

exercises.name: Band push-up
exercises.about: Push-up with a band across your back held under each hand. The band gets harder near the top.

exercises.name: Incline bench press
exercises.about: Bench set to about 30 degrees to work the upper chest. Lower to the top of the chest, keep shoulder blades pinned, press straight up.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
exercises.about: Upper-chest press with dumbbells on a low incline. Let the elbows sit around 45 degrees from the body; press up and slightly together.

exercises.name: Incline machine press
exercises.about: Machine press angled upward for the upper chest. Keep the chest up and the back on the pad.

exercises.name: Smith incline press
exercises.about: Incline press on a fixed track. Line the bar up with the upper chest; easy to push near failure safely.

exercises.name: Low-to-high cable press
exercises.about: Press from low pulleys up and forward for the upper chest with constant tension.

exercises.name: Landmine chest press
exercises.about: Press one end of a landmine bar up from the chest, kneeling or standing. Shoulder-friendly upper-chest pressing.

exercises.name: Reverse-grip bench press
exercises.about: Bench press with palms facing you. Hits the upper chest and triceps; use a spotter and a careful grip.

exercises.name: Incline push-up
exercises.about: Push-up with hands on a bench. Easier than the floor; good for high reps or warm-ups.

exercises.name: Decline push-up
exercises.about: Push-up with feet raised on a bench, which shifts work toward the upper chest and shoulders.

exercises.name: Machine chest fly (pec deck)
exercises.about: Machine fly. Sit tall, slight bend in the elbows, bring the handles together in a hugging arc and squeeze. Do not let the arms swing too far back.

exercises.name: Cable fly
exercises.about: Stand between two high pulleys and bring the handles together in front of you. Constant tension; think of hugging a big tree.

exercises.name: Dumbbell fly
exercises.about: Lie flat, arms slightly bent, open wide until you feel a chest stretch, then bring the weights back up in an arc. Go light and controlled.

exercises.name: Low-to-high cable fly
exercises.about: Fly from low pulleys up to face height for the upper chest.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell fly
exercises.about: Fly on an incline bench for the upper chest. Keep the elbows soft and stop at a comfortable stretch.

exercises.name: Band fly
exercises.about: Anchor a band behind you and bring the ends together in front. A light pump exercise for the chest.

exercises.name: Plate squeeze press
exercises.about: Squeeze a plate between your palms at chest height and press it straight out. Constant inner-chest squeeze; log the plate weight.

exercises.name: Cable crossover
exercises.about: Pulleys at shoulder height, step forward and cross the hands slightly at the end. Great finisher for a chest day.

exercises.name: Overhead press
exercises.about: Standing barbell press. Squeeze glutes and brace, press the bar straight up past your face, then push your head through at the top. Do not lean back.

exercises.name: Seated dumbbell shoulder press
exercises.about: Sit with back support, dumbbells at ear height, press up until arms are nearly straight. Keep the ribs down.

exercises.name: Machine shoulder press
exercises.about: Guided overhead press. Set the seat so handles start at shoulder height and press without arching your lower back.

exercises.name: Smith overhead press
exercises.about: Standing or seated press on the Smith track; lets you focus on pushing hard.

exercises.name: Kettlebell press
exercises.about: Clean a kettlebell to the shoulder and press it overhead, fist up, biceps by the ear. Works shoulders and core stability.

exercises.name: Landmine press
exercises.about: Press the end of a landmine bar up and forward with one arm. Very shoulder-friendly pressing.

exercises.name: Seated Smith shoulder press
exercises.about: Seated press on the Smith machine with back support.

exercises.name: Seated barbell press
exercises.about: Overhead press from a seat with back support. Less lower-back demand than standing.

exercises.name: Push press
exercises.about: Dip the knees slightly and drive up to help the bar overhead, then lock it out. Lets you handle more than a strict press.

exercises.name: Arnold press
exercises.about: Start palms facing you at chin height, rotate them outward as you press up. Works all three heads of the shoulder.

exercises.name: Standing dumbbell press
exercises.about: Standing press with dumbbells; brace the core and keep ribs down.

exercises.name: Pike push-up
exercises.about: Hips high in an upside-down V, lower your head toward the floor between your hands. Bodyweight shoulder press.

exercises.name: Handstand push-up
exercises.about: Kick up to a handstand against a wall and lower your head to the floor, then press back up. Advanced.

exercises.name: Band overhead press
exercises.about: Stand on a band and press the handles overhead. Light, joint-friendly pressing.

exercises.name: Z press
exercises.about: Seated on the floor, legs straight, press a barbell overhead. Brutal for core and strict shoulder strength.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lateral raise
exercises.about: Raise dumbbells out to the sides until arms are level with shoulders, leading with the elbows. Light weight, no swinging. Builds wider shoulders.

exercises.name: Cable lateral raise
exercises.about: One arm at a time from a low pulley across the body. Constant tension on the side delt.

exercises.name: Machine lateral raise
exercises.about: Pads on the upper arms; raise to shoulder height. Easy to keep strict.

exercises.name: Kettlebell lateral raise
exercises.about: Lateral raise holding kettlebells by the handle. Same form as dumbbells.

exercises.name: Cable upright row
exercises.about: Pull a bar or rope up along the body to chest height, elbows high and wide. Stop before shoulders pinch.

exercises.name: Leaning lateral raise
exercises.about: Hold a post and lean away, raise one dumbbell out to the side. Longer range for the side delt.

exercises.name: Band lateral raise
exercises.about: Stand on a band and raise the ends out to the sides. Good high-rep pump.

exercises.name: Barbell upright row
exercises.about: Pull a barbell up close to the body to chest height, elbows leading. Use a wider grip to keep it shoulder-friendly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell front raise
exercises.about: Raise dumbbells straight in front to shoulder height. Works the front delt; often already busy from pressing, so keep it light.

exercises.name: Cable front raise
exercises.about: Front raise from a low pulley between the legs. Smooth tension through the whole lift.

exercises.name: Plate front raise
exercises.about: Hold a plate at both sides and raise it to eye level. Log the plate weight.

exercises.name: Barbell front raise
exercises.about: Front raise with a light barbell or EZ bar, arms nearly straight.

exercises.name: Band front raise
exercises.about: Stand on a band and raise it in front to shoulder height.

exercises.name: Machine reverse fly (rear delt)
exercises.about: Face the pec deck and open the arms back in a wide arc. Works the rear shoulder, which balances all the pressing.

exercises.name: Face pull
exercises.about: Rope at face height, pull toward your forehead with elbows high and hands apart. Great for shoulder health.

exercises.name: Dumbbell rear delt fly
exercises.about: Bend forward with a flat back and raise light dumbbells out to the sides. Lead with the elbows.

exercises.name: Cable rear delt fly
exercises.about: Cross the cables at shoulder height and pull them apart behind you. Constant tension on the rear delts.

exercises.name: Band pull-apart
exercises.about: Hold a band at shoulder height with straight arms and pull it apart to your chest. Simple, great warm-up.

exercises.name: Chest-supported rear fly
exercises.about: Lie chest-down on an incline bench and raise dumbbells out to the sides. Takes the lower back out of it.

exercises.name: Barbell row
exercises.about: Hinge forward with a flat back, pull the bar to your lower ribs, squeeze, lower under control. Keep the torso still.

exercises.name: One-arm dumbbell row
exercises.about: One hand and knee on a bench, pull the dumbbell toward your hip. Big range, easy on the lower back.

exercises.name: Chest-supported row
exercises.about: Chest on the pad, pull the handles back and squeeze the shoulder blades. No lower-back strain.

exercises.name: Seated cable row
exercises.about: Sit tall, pull the handle to your stomach, chest up, then let the shoulders stretch forward. Do not rock.

exercises.name: T-bar row
exercises.about: Straddle a landmine bar and row the handle to your chest. Heavy upper-back work.

exercises.name: Smith row
exercises.about: Bent-over row on the Smith track. Steady path, lets you focus on the squeeze.

exercises.name: Chest-supported dumbbell row
exercises.about: Lie chest-down on an incline bench and row two dumbbells. Strict and back-friendly.

exercises.name: Inverted row
exercises.about: Hang under a bar or Smith bar with straight body, pull your chest up to it. Lower the bar or raise feet to make it harder.

exercises.name: Kettlebell row
exercises.about: One-arm row with a kettlebell; same form as the dumbbell row.

exercises.name: Wide-grip cable row
exercises.about: Seated row with a wide bar, pulling to the upper stomach with elbows out. More upper back and rear delt.

exercises.name: Machine row
exercises.about: Seated row machine. Chest on the pad, drive elbows back.

exercises.name: Pendlay row
exercises.about: Barbell row from the floor each rep with the torso near flat. Explosive pull, reset on the ground.

exercises.name: Seal row
exercises.about: Lie face down on a high bench and row the bar up to it. Zero cheating, zero lower-back load.

exercises.name: Meadows row
exercises.about: Stand side-on to a landmine and row the bar end with one hand. Big stretch for the lats.

exercises.name: Underhand barbell row
exercises.about: Barbell row with palms up and a more upright torso, pulling to the stomach. More lats and biceps.

exercises.name: Single-arm cable row
exercises.about: Seated or standing one-arm row from a cable. Let the shoulder reach forward, then pull to the hip.

exercises.name: Band row
exercises.about: Anchor a band at chest height and row it to your stomach. Good at home or as a warm-up.

exercises.name: Plate-loaded high row
exercises.about: Plate-loaded row pulling down and back. Works the upper back and lats hard.

exercises.name: Suspension row
exercises.about: Lean back holding suspension straps and pull your chest to the handles. Walk feet forward to make it harder.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.about: Grip a little wider than shoulders, pull the bar to your upper chest, elbows down and back. Lean back only slightly.

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.about: Hang with palms away, pull until your chin is over the bar, lower all the way. Add weight with a belt when you can do plenty.

exercises.name: Chin-up
exercises.about: Pull-up with palms facing you. More biceps, often easier than a pull-up.

exercises.name: Machine pulldown
exercises.about: Lever pulldown machine. Pull the handles down toward your sides and squeeze the lats.

exercises.name: Assisted pull-up machine
exercises.about: Pull-up with a pad pushing you up. Log the assistance as the weight; less assistance means progress.

exercises.name: Close-grip pulldown
exercises.about: Pulldown with a narrow V-handle to the upper chest. Long range for the lats.

exercises.name: Neutral-grip pull-up
exercises.about: Pull-up on parallel handles, palms facing each other. The most joint-friendly pull-up grip.

exercises.name: Single-arm cable pulldown
exercises.about: Kneel or sit and pull one handle down to your side. Lets each lat work fully.

exercises.name: Band pulldown
exercises.about: Anchor a band high and pull it down to your chest, elbows to the sides.

exercises.name: Band-assisted pull-up
exercises.about: Pull-up with a band under your knee or foot to help. Use thinner bands as you get stronger.

exercises.name: Kneeling cable pulldown
exercises.about: Kneel in front of a high cable and pull a bar down to your chest. Simple alternative when the pulldown station is busy.

exercises.name: Straight-arm pulldown
exercises.about: Arms nearly straight, push the bar or rope from eye level down to your thighs. Feels the lats without the biceps.

exercises.name: Dumbbell pullover
exercises.about: Lie across a bench holding one dumbbell over your chest, lower it behind your head, pull it back over. Stretches lats and chest.

exercises.name: Pullover machine
exercises.about: Machine that lets the lats pull the arms down in an arc. Very direct lat work.

exercises.name: Band straight-arm pulldown
exercises.about: Straight-arm pulldown with a band anchored high.

exercises.name: Back squat
exercises.about: Bar on the upper back, brace hard, sit down between your hips until thighs are at least level, stand up driving through the whole foot. Knees track over toes.

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.about: Bar resting on the front of the shoulders, elbows high. Upright torso, very quad-heavy and easier on the back.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.about: Feet shoulder-width on the platform, lower until knees are well bent without the lower back lifting, press back up. Big leg work with no balance needed.

exercises.name: Hack squat
exercises.about: Back on the pad, shoulders under the pads, squat deep. Heavy quad work with the back supported.

exercises.name: Smith squat
exercises.about: Squat on the Smith track. Feet slightly in front lets you sit back; good for pushing hard safely.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.about: Hold one dumbbell at your chest and squat between your knees. Teaches a great upright squat.

exercises.name: Kettlebell goblet squat
exercises.about: Goblet squat holding a kettlebell by the horns at your chest. Sit down between your knees with an upright torso.

exercises.name: Pendulum squat
exercises.about: Swinging-arc squat machine. Deep knee bend, very quad-focused, light on the back.

exercises.name: Belt squat
exercises.about: Load hangs from a hip belt, so legs work hard with no load on the spine.

exercises.name: Safety bar squat
exercises.about: Squat with a cambered, padded bar and handles in front. Easier on shoulders and wrists.

exercises.name: Box squat
exercises.about: Sit back onto a box, pause, then stand. Teaches depth and builds power out of the hole.

exercises.name: Pause squat
exercises.about: Back squat with a 2-second pause at the bottom. Builds strength where most people stall.

exercises.name: Zercher squat
exercises.about: Hold the bar in the crook of the elbows and squat. Very upright, hard on the core.

exercises.name: Dumbbell squat
exercises.about: Squat holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides. Keep the chest up and sit between the hips; a simple way to load squats without a rack.

exercises.name: Bodyweight squat
exercises.about: Squat with no weight, arms forward for balance. Warm-up or high-rep finisher.

exercises.name: V-squat machine
exercises.about: Plate-loaded squat machine with shoulder pads; quad-friendly and stable.

exercises.name: Band squat
exercises.about: Stand on a band with it over the shoulders and squat. Gets harder at the top.

exercises.name: Single-leg leg press
exercises.about: Leg press with one leg at a time. Evens out left/right differences.

exercises.name: Seated leg press
exercises.about: Seated horizontal leg press. Same idea as the sled; keep the lower back on the pad.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bulgarian split squat
exercises.about: Back foot on a bench, front foot forward, drop straight down until the back knee nearly touches the floor. Tough but very effective.

exercises.name: Dumbbell walking lunge
exercises.about: Step forward into a lunge, push through the front heel and step into the next one. Keep the torso tall.

exercises.name: Smith split squat
exercises.about: Split squat on the Smith track for extra balance.

exercises.name: Dumbbell step-up
exercises.about: Step onto a box with one foot and stand up fully, without pushing off the back foot. Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Barbell reverse lunge
exercises.about: Step back into a lunge and return. Easier on the knees than forward lunges.

exercises.name: Kettlebell lunge
exercises.about: Lunge holding a kettlebell in each hand or at the chest.

exercises.name: Dumbbell reverse lunge
exercises.about: Step back into a lunge holding dumbbells. Knee-friendly single-leg work.

exercises.name: Barbell split squat
exercises.about: Split stance with a bar on your back, drop the back knee toward the floor.

exercises.name: Bodyweight lunge
exercises.about: Lunges with no load. Good warm-up or high-rep burnout.

exercises.name: Lateral lunge
exercises.about: Step wide to the side and sit into that hip, other leg straight. Works inner thighs too.

exercises.name: Curtsy lunge
exercises.about: Step one leg behind and across, like a curtsy. Hits the outer glutes.

exercises.name: Pistol squat
exercises.about: Squat all the way down on one leg with the other straight in front. Advanced balance and strength.

exercises.name: Cable split squat
exercises.about: Split squat holding a low cable handle. Smooth constant load.

exercises.name: Band split squat
exercises.about: Split squat standing on a band held at the shoulders.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.about: Bar over mid-foot, grip just outside the legs, chest up and back flat. Push the floor away and stand tall; lower the same way. Brace before every rep.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
exercises.about: Start standing, push the hips back with soft knees, slide the bar down the thighs until hamstrings stretch, then drive the hips forward.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.about: Romanian deadlift with dumbbells in front of the thighs. Hips back, flat back, feel the stretch.

exercises.name: Trap bar deadlift
exercises.about: Stand inside a hex bar and lift with a more upright torso. Easier on the back than a straight-bar deadlift.

exercises.name: Kettlebell swing
exercises.about: Hike the bell back between the legs, snap the hips forward to float it to chest height. Power from the hips, not the arms.

exercises.name: Smith Romanian deadlift
exercises.about: Romanian deadlift on the Smith machine. A fixed path that helps you focus on the hamstrings.

exercises.name: 45° back extension
exercises.about: Hips on the pad, lower your chest toward the floor and raise back to a straight line. Hold a plate to load it.

exercises.name: Cable pull-through
exercises.about: Face away from a low cable with a rope between your legs, hinge back and drive the hips forward. Teaches the hip hinge.

exercises.name: Kettlebell deadlift
exercises.about: Deadlift a kettlebell from between the feet. A gentle way to learn the movement.

exercises.name: Sumo deadlift
exercises.about: Wide stance, hands inside the knees, push the knees out and stand up. Shorter range and more upright.

exercises.name: Stiff-leg deadlift
exercises.about: Deadlift with nearly straight legs from the floor. Long hamstring stretch; go lighter than a normal deadlift.

exercises.name: Good morning
exercises.about: Bar on the back, push the hips back with soft knees until your torso is near level, then stand. Light and strict.

exercises.name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
exercises.about: Hinge on one leg with the other reaching back, dumbbell in the opposite hand. Balance and hamstrings in one.

exercises.name: Rack pull
exercises.about: Deadlift from pins at knee height. Overloads the top half and the upper back.

exercises.name: Deficit deadlift
exercises.about: Deadlift standing on a plate so the bar starts lower. Builds speed off the floor.

exercises.name: Reverse hyper
exercises.about: Lie face down on the machine and swing the legs up behind you. Strengthens the lower back without loading the spine.

exercises.name: Band good morning
exercises.about: Stand on a band looped behind the neck and hinge forward. Light hinge practice.

exercises.name: Glute-ham raise
exercises.about: On a GHD, lower your body forward from the knees and curl yourself back up with the hamstrings. Very hard; use arms to assist at first.

exercises.name: Barbell hip thrust
exercises.about: Upper back on a bench, bar over the hips, drive the hips up until the body is flat, squeeze hard at the top, chin tucked.

exercises.name: Machine hip thrust
exercises.about: Hip thrust machine with a padded belt. Same movement with easier setup.

exercises.name: Smith hip thrust
exercises.about: Hip thrust under the Smith bar for a stable path.

exercises.name: Dumbbell hip thrust
exercises.about: Hip thrust with a dumbbell held across the hips. Upper back on a bench, drive the hips up to a flat line and squeeze the glutes at the top.

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.about: Lying on the floor, drive the hips up and squeeze. Add a weight on the hips to progress.

exercises.name: Barbell glute bridge
exercises.about: Glute bridge from the floor with a barbell over the hips. Shorter range, can go heavy.

exercises.name: Single-leg hip thrust
exercises.about: Hip thrust on one leg. Hard without any weight.

exercises.name: Band hip thrust
exercises.about: Hip thrust with a band pinned over the hips. Gets hardest at the top.

exercises.name: Kettlebell hip thrust
exercises.about: Hip thrust with a kettlebell held on the hips. Good when the barbell is busy; squeeze hard at the top.

exercises.name: Cable glute kickback
exercises.about: Ankle strap on a low cable, kick the leg straight back without arching the lower back.

exercises.name: Hip abduction machine
exercises.about: Sit and push the pads outward. Works the side glutes that steady your hips.

exercises.name: Glute kickback machine
exercises.about: Kickback machine; push the platform back with one leg and squeeze.

exercises.name: Band kickback
exercises.about: Band around the ankles or anchored low, kick one leg back.

exercises.name: Cable hip abduction
exercises.about: Stand side-on with an ankle strap and lift the leg out to the side.

exercises.name: Band lateral walk
exercises.about: Band above the knees, half squat, step side to side keeping tension. Great glute warm-up.

exercises.name: Frog pump
exercises.about: Lie on your back with soles together, knees out, and pump the hips up. High-rep glute burner.

exercises.name: Leg extension
exercises.about: Sit with the pad on your shins and straighten your knees, pause, lower slowly. Pure quad work.

exercises.name: Cable leg extension
exercises.about: Ankle strap on a low cable, sit and straighten the knee.

exercises.name: Sissy squat
exercises.about: Lean back and let your knees travel forward as you lower, hips straight. Intense quad stretch.

exercises.name: Single-leg extension
exercises.about: Leg extension one leg at a time to even out each side.

exercises.name: Band leg extension
exercises.about: Seated, band from behind around the ankle, straighten the knee.

exercises.name: Reverse Nordic
exercises.about: Kneel upright and lean back slowly with a straight line from knees to head. Strong quad stretch.

exercises.name: Lying leg curl
exercises.about: Lie face down, pad behind the ankles, curl the heels toward your glutes. Keep the hips down.

exercises.name: Seated leg curl
exercises.about: Sit with the pad behind the ankles and curl down and back. The stretched hip position makes it very effective.

exercises.name: Dumbbell leg curl
exercises.about: Lie face down with a dumbbell between the feet and curl it up. Go light and slow.

exercises.name: Standing cable leg curl
exercises.about: Ankle strap on a low cable, curl one heel up behind you.

exercises.name: Nordic curl
exercises.about: Kneel with feet anchored and lower your body forward as slowly as you can. Very strong hamstring builder.

exercises.name: Standing leg curl machine
exercises.about: One leg at a time on a standing curl machine: pad behind the ankle, curl the heel up toward your glute and lower slowly.

exercises.name: Band leg curl
exercises.about: Face down, band around the ankle anchored in front, curl the heel up.

exercises.name: Slider leg curl
exercises.about: Lie on your back with heels on sliders, hips up, slide the heels in and out.

exercises.name: Standing calf raise
exercises.about: Shoulders under the pads, rise onto your toes as high as you can, pause, lower to a full stretch.

exercises.name: Seated calf raise
exercises.about: Pad on the knees, lift the heels. Bent knees work the deeper calf muscle.

exercises.name: Leg press calf raise
exercises.about: Toes on the bottom edge of the leg press platform; push with the ankles only.

exercises.name: Smith calf raise
exercises.about: Calf raise under the Smith bar, toes on a plate for extra range.

exercises.name: Dumbbell calf raise
exercises.about: Hold dumbbells and do calf raises, ideally with toes on a step.

exercises.name: Single-leg calf raise
exercises.about: Calf raise on one foot from a step. Add a dumbbell when easy.

exercises.name: Donkey calf raise
exercises.about: Bent forward at the hips, rise up on the toes. Great stretch on the calves.

exercises.name: Barbell calf raise
exercises.about: Calf raise with a barbell on your back, toes on a plate or step. Rise as high as you can, pause, then lower to a full stretch.

exercises.name: Tibialis raise
exercises.about: Back against a wall, heels out, lift your toes toward your shins. Works the shin muscle and helps knees.

exercises.name: Hip adduction machine
exercises.about: Squeeze the pads together. Works the inner thighs.

exercises.name: Copenhagen plank
exercises.about: Side plank with the top leg on a bench, bottom leg off the floor. Tough inner-thigh and core hold.

exercises.name: Cable hip adduction
exercises.about: Ankle strap on the inside leg, pull it across the body.

exercises.name: Band adduction
exercises.about: Band anchored to the side at ankle height; pull the leg inward.

exercises.name: Barbell curl
exercises.about: Elbows pinned at your sides, curl the bar up, squeeze, lower slowly. Do not swing the hips.

exercises.name: EZ-bar curl
exercises.about: Curl with the angled EZ bar; easier on the wrists than a straight bar.

exercises.name: Dumbbell curl
exercises.about: Curl dumbbells with palms turning up as they rise. Keep the upper arms still.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell curl
exercises.about: Lie back on an incline bench, arms hanging, and curl. The stretch makes the biceps work hard.

exercises.name: Hammer curl
exercises.about: Curl with palms facing each other. Builds the outer arm and forearms.

exercises.name: Cable curl
exercises.about: Curl a bar from a low pulley. Constant tension top to bottom.

exercises.name: Machine preacher curl
exercises.about: Arms on the pad, curl up. The pad stops any cheating.

exercises.name: Dumbbell preacher curl
exercises.about: One arm on a preacher pad, curl the dumbbell. Strict and hard at the bottom.

exercises.name: Kettlebell curl
exercises.about: Curl kettlebells by the handle; the offset weight works the grip too.

exercises.name: EZ-bar preacher curl
exercises.about: Preacher curl with an EZ bar. Lower slowly to a near-straight arm.

exercises.name: Spider curl
exercises.about: Chest down on an incline bench, arms hanging straight down, curl up. Very hard at the top.

exercises.name: Concentration curl
exercises.about: Seated, elbow braced on the inner thigh, curl one dumbbell. Great mind-muscle feel.

exercises.name: Behind-the-body cable curl
exercises.about: Face away from a low cable, arm slightly behind you, and curl. Loads the biceps in the stretch.

exercises.name: Rope hammer curl
exercises.about: Hammer curl with a rope on a low cable, thumbs up. Keeps tension on the biceps and forearms the whole way; keep elbows at your sides.

exercises.name: Reverse curl
exercises.about: Curl with palms facing down. Builds the forearms and the muscle under the biceps.

exercises.name: Zottman curl
exercises.about: Curl palms up, turn palms down at the top, lower slowly. Biceps and forearms together.

exercises.name: Drag curl
exercises.about: Drag the bar up the front of your body with elbows moving back. Hits the long head of the biceps.

exercises.name: Band curl
exercises.about: Stand on a band and curl. Simple pump work anywhere.

exercises.name: Single-arm cable curl
exercises.about: One-arm curl from a low cable, turning the palm up as you rise.

exercises.name: Chin-up negative
exercises.about: Jump to the top of a chin-up and lower as slowly as possible. Builds strength for full chin-ups.

exercises.name: Cable triceps pushdown
exercises.about: Elbows tucked at your sides, push the bar down until arms are straight, squeeze, let it up under control.

exercises.name: Rope pushdown
exercises.about: Pushdown with a rope, spreading the ends apart at the bottom.

exercises.name: Overhead cable triceps extension
exercises.about: Face away from the cable, rope behind your head, straighten your arms overhead. Stretches the long head of the triceps.

exercises.name: Dumbbell overhead triceps extension
exercises.about: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands, lower it behind your head, press back up.

exercises.name: EZ-bar skull crusher
exercises.about: Lying on a bench, lower the bar toward your forehead by bending only the elbows, then straighten.

exercises.name: Close-grip bench press
exercises.about: Bench press with hands about shoulder-width and elbows close. Heavy triceps work.

exercises.name: Machine triceps extension
exercises.about: Seated triceps machine; push the handles down and straighten the arms.

exercises.name: Machine dip
exercises.about: Seated dip machine; push the handles down. All the dip, none of the balance.

exercises.name: Dumbbell skull crusher
exercises.about: Lying extension with dumbbells, palms facing each other. Easier on the elbows.

exercises.name: Bench dip
exercises.about: Hands on a bench behind you, lower your hips and press back up. Keep the shoulders from rolling forward.

exercises.name: Close-grip push-up
exercises.about: Push-up with hands close together under the chest. Bodyweight triceps work.

exercises.name: Dumbbell kickback
exercises.about: Bent over, upper arm level with your body, straighten the elbow to kick the dumbbell back.

exercises.name: Cable kickback
exercises.about: Kickback with a low cable; tension stays on at the top.

exercises.name: JM press
exercises.about: A mix of close-grip bench and skull crusher: lower the bar toward your chin, then press. Heavy triceps builder.

exercises.name: Single-arm pushdown
exercises.about: Pushdown with one handle, palm up or down. Evens out the arms.

exercises.name: Band pushdown
exercises.about: Band anchored high, push down to straight arms.

exercises.name: Weighted dip
exercises.about: Dips with a weight on a belt, staying fairly upright for triceps. Log the added weight.

exercises.name: Tate press
exercises.about: Lying, dumbbells over the chest, bend the elbows out so the bells touch your chest, then press back up.

exercises.name: Barbell shrug
exercises.about: Hold the bar at arm's length and lift your shoulders straight up toward your ears, pause, lower. No rolling.

exercises.name: Dumbbell shrug
exercises.about: Hold heavy dumbbells at your sides and lift the shoulders straight up toward the ears. Pause at the top; no rolling the shoulders.

exercises.name: Smith shrug
exercises.about: Shrug on the Smith machine; easy to load heavy.

exercises.name: Machine shrug
exercises.about: Shrug on a shrug machine or plate-loaded station. Lift the shoulders straight up, hold a second, lower slowly. Easy to load heavy.

exercises.name: Cable shrug
exercises.about: Shrug a straight bar from a low cable. The cable keeps tension at the bottom; lift straight up and squeeze the traps.

exercises.name: Kettlebell shrug
exercises.about: Shrug holding a kettlebell in each hand. Lift the shoulders straight up and pause; the handles let you grip comfortably.

exercises.name: Trap bar shrug
exercises.about: Shrug inside a hex bar; the neutral grip feels natural.

exercises.name: Farmer carry
exercises.about: Pick up heavy dumbbells and walk tall for time or distance. Grip, traps and core. Log seconds as reps.

exercises.name: Kettlebell farmer carry
exercises.about: Farmer carry with a heavy kettlebell in each hand. Walk tall with short steps for time or distance. Works grip, traps and core. Log seconds.

exercises.name: Trap bar carry
exercises.about: Lift a loaded hex bar and walk. Lets you carry a lot.

exercises.name: Suitcase carry
exercises.about: Carry one heavy dumbbell on one side and walk without leaning. A sneaky core exercise.

exercises.name: Sled push
exercises.about: Lean into a sled and drive it forward with short powerful steps. Leg power with no lowering phase. Log seconds; weight = plates on the sled.

exercises.name: Dead hang
exercises.about: Hang from a pull-up bar as long as you can. Builds grip and opens the shoulders. Log seconds.

exercises.name: Dumbbell wrist curl
exercises.about: Forearms on your thighs, palms up, curl the wrists up and down.

exercises.name: Cable wrist curl
exercises.about: Wrist curls with a bar on a low cable, forearms resting on your thighs. Curl the wrists up and lower all the way for forearm strength.

exercises.name: Reverse wrist curl
exercises.about: Wrist curl with palms down, for the top of the forearm.

exercises.name: Barbell wrist curl
exercises.about: Seated, forearms on the thighs, curl a light barbell with the wrists.

exercises.name: Plate pinch
exercises.about: Pinch two smooth plates together and hold for time. Thumb and finger strength. Log seconds.

exercises.name: Wrist roller
exercises.about: Roll a weight up on a rope by twisting a handle, then lower it. Big forearm pump. Log rolls as reps.

exercises.name: Neck extension (band)
exercises.about: Band around the back of the head, gently nod back against it. Light and controlled.

exercises.name: Plate neck curl
exercises.about: Lie on a bench, plate on the forehead (with a towel), slowly nod up and down. Go very light.

exercises.name: Cable crunch
exercises.about: Kneel under a high rope, crunch your ribs toward your hips. Move from the spine, not the hips.

exercises.name: Machine crunch
exercises.about: Ab crunch machine; curl the chest toward the knees.

exercises.name: Hanging leg raise
exercises.about: Hang from a bar and raise your legs, curling the pelvis up. Bent knees make it easier.

exercises.name: Captain's chair knee raise
exercises.about: Forearms on the pads, back on the pad, raise the knees toward your chest.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.about: Forearms and toes, straight line from head to heels, squeeze glutes and abs. Log seconds.

exercises.name: Ab wheel rollout
exercises.about: From the knees, roll the wheel out as far as you can without the lower back sagging, then pull back.

exercises.name: Pallof press
exercises.about: Side-on to a cable at chest height, press the handle straight out and resist the twist.

exercises.name: Dumbbell side bend
exercises.about: Hold a dumbbell on one side and bend sideways, then return. Works the side of the waist.

exercises.name: Kettlebell windmill
exercises.about: Bell locked overhead, push the hips out and reach down to the opposite foot. Slow and controlled.

exercises.name: Cable woodchop
exercises.about: Pull a cable diagonally across your body from high to low (or low to high), turning through the trunk.

exercises.name: Decline sit-up
exercises.about: Feet hooked on a decline bench, sit up and lower slowly. Hold a plate to load it.

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.about: On one forearm and the side of your foot, body straight. Log seconds per side.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.about: On your back, arms up and knees bent, lower the opposite arm and leg while keeping the lower back flat.

exercises.name: Hollow body hold
exercises.about: Lie on your back, arms and legs off the floor, lower back pressed down. Log seconds.

exercises.name: Russian twist
exercises.about: Sit leaning back with feet up, rotate a weight side to side. Log each side as a rep.

exercises.name: Lying leg raise
exercises.about: On your back, raise straight legs up and lower slowly without the lower back arching.

exercises.name: Reverse crunch
exercises.about: On your back, curl the knees and hips up off the floor toward your chest.

exercises.name: Crunch
exercises.about: Lie on your back and curl your ribs toward your hips. Small, controlled movement.

exercises.name: Weighted plank
exercises.about: Plank with a plate on your back. Log the plate as weight and seconds as reps.

exercises.name: Bird dog
exercises.about: On hands and knees, reach one arm and the opposite leg out long, hold, switch. Back-friendly core work.

exercises.name: Landmine rotation
exercises.about: Hold the end of a landmine bar overhead and rotate it side to side in an arc.

exercises.name: Cable side bend
exercises.about: Stand side-on to a low cable holding the handle and bend away from it, then return. Works the side of the waist (obliques).

exercises.name: Band Pallof press
exercises.about: Pallof press with a band anchored to the side.

exercises.name: Toes to bar
exercises.about: Hang and lift your toes to touch the bar. Advanced, needs control.

exercises.name: Dragon flag
exercises.about: Lying on a bench, hold behind your head and lower your straight body from the shoulders. Very advanced.

exercises.name: Stir the pot
exercises.about: Forearm plank on a stability ball, draw small circles. Brutal for the abs.

exercises.name: Suitcase deadlift
exercises.about: Deadlift one dumbbell at your side without leaning. Core anti-bend strength.

exercises.name: Kettlebell march
exercises.about: Hold kettlebells and march in place, lifting knees high. Core and grip; log seconds.

exercises.name: Power clean
exercises.about: Pull the bar from the floor, jump it up with the hips and catch it on the shoulders in a quarter squat. Technical; learn it with light weight first.

exercises.name: Hang clean
exercises.about: Start with the bar at mid-thigh, dip and explode up, catch on the shoulders.

exercises.name: Hang power snatch
exercises.about: Wide grip from mid-thigh, explode up and punch the bar overhead in one move.

exercises.name: Clean and jerk
exercises.about: Clean the bar to the shoulders, then drive it overhead with the legs. Full-body power.

exercises.name: Thruster
exercises.about: Front squat and drive straight into an overhead press in one move. Huge conditioning lift.

exercises.name: Dumbbell thruster
exercises.about: Thruster with dumbbells at the shoulders.

exercises.name: Dumbbell snatch
exercises.about: One dumbbell from between the feet straight overhead in one explosive pull.

exercises.name: Kettlebell clean
exercises.about: Swing the bell back and pull it into the rack position at the shoulder, wrist straight.

exercises.name: Kettlebell snatch
exercises.about: Swing the bell and punch it straight overhead in one move. Great conditioning.

exercises.name: Barbell high pull
exercises.about: Explode from mid-thigh and pull the bar to chest height, elbows high.

exercises.name: Box jump
exercises.about: Jump onto a box landing softly, step down. Leg power; log jumps as reps.

exercises.name: Medicine ball slam
exercises.about: Lift a slam ball overhead and throw it down hard. Log ball weight and reps.

exercises.name: Kettlebell swing to goblet squat
exercises.about: Swing the bell up, catch it at the chest and squat. Flowing full-body work.
